## Checklist
Before submitting your PR, please review and check the following:

### For All PRs
- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my changes
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or errors

### For New Skills
- [ ] SKILL.md has proper YAML frontmatter
- [ ] LICENSE.txt is included
- [ ] Skill is listed in SKILLS_CATALOG.md
- [ ] Examples are clear and practical
- [ ] Documentation is bilingual (English/Chinese) where appropriate

### For Skill Modifications
- [ ] Changes maintain backward compatibility
- [ ] Documentation is updated accordingly
- [ ] Examples still work correctly

### For Code Changes
- [ ] Code has been tested
- [ ] Dependencies are documented
- [ ] Scripts include proper error handling
